title: The window unit in krn ledger, with one price table
body:
Outcome: `krn ledger --window <from> <to>` and `--last <n>` print PRs, tasks closed done, dollars for lead and subagents, PRs per task, created-to-merged, `CI` attempts and main reds; the ledger and `spend-window.py` read one price table.
Why: cost per PR hides sessions that deliver nothing and tasks that take several PRs; the second price table dropped every Fable turn from the ledger within one commit of #539 (`04` (b)).
Proof: the window 11-09 21:00Z to 22:20Z reproduces the script to the cent (**[R]** V10 re-ran this one window, with `--root` at the main checkout; the silent $0.00 from a worktree is A6's to fix); #454, #477 and #463 join to `t-wm22s14`, `t-6zyegcr`, `t-b6v615x`.
Scope: `src/outcome`, `scripts/claude/spend-window.py`; evidence `spike-b.diff`.
Order: B1, B2, B3; then the two measurements B6 and B7; B4 when the operator adds the line; B5 last.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice B1.
